name: Kinoshita Kotomi
source:
Due to illness, was unable to to go to high school and had to stay at home. Went to "Shooting Star Garden" to fulfill her dreams of going to a university.

Because she was sick since her childhood and had to spend a lot of time at her home, was not good at socializing with the opposite sex. Despite that, she is a brave girl, who always tries to appear cheerful in front of the protagonist.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050507113109/http://210.166.209.38:80/html/soft/flove/chara_a.htm]website[/url]]
